for: Quarterdeck final design PR 3: what item 1 changes in the example data
author: Quarterdeck contributors
how: Merge by id into the example data. `lanesChanged` replaces `name`, `status` and `now` of the Lane where it gives them, and `activityText` replaces the text of the Activity line with that time and bot (time, bot and refs stay, so no last-looked count changes). `activityAdded` appends these Activity lines to the Lane (the build orders Activity newest first). `newLanes`, `newTaskCards`, `answeredOutcome`, `evidence` and `aboutLines` add one Lane and one answered sign-off Task Card with its evidence.

Every line in `activityAdded` is older than its Lane's last-looked time (so it changes no new count) except two: l-sw2's Sun 4:00 PM line and l-da1's Mon 9:00 AM line. addendum-seen.json restates every Lane's new count and the project counts.

`waitingComputed` is what the build counts from the rows. The stored `waiting` of l-set is 3 only because it counts the FYI card alba-2 that the design spec removes; the computed total is 9. The blocker on c1 uses c1's new title from the the ruling sweep (the addendum item 6); every id stays.
The new Lane adds no `tasks` rows, so the Project view's 'Tasks: N done · N in progress' is unchanged.
